verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's marketing describes in-product AI agents for customer screening, ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. These agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk or complex cases for human review, which is AI-driven triage of the user's own data. That is AI acting on alerts rather than clearly surfacing insights or suggestions to the user, and it is evidenced only by thin marketing-page mentions. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights, explanations or recommendations shown to users, detail on how agent outputs appear in the case UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
